evidence.notes: Metadata deploy problem type enum constants materialize as passive Apex enum values; deployment execution is not claimed.
Feed item type enum constants are passive DTO shape values.
Feed layout enum constants are passive Metadata DTO shape values.
Platform action enum constants are passive Metadata DTO shape values; no action invocation is claimed.
This covers only the Metadata enum constant shape, not Invocable action execution.
